::: {#exm-feature-engineering}

#### Center ink and left ink

Center ink (@sol-zero-or-one) and left ink (@sol-three-or-eight) are engineered features.
Each one encodes a fact a person noticed about the shapes of digits:
a 0 is empty in the middle, so its center ink averages `r round(mean(py$center_ink[py$labels == 0]), 1)`
against `r round(mean(py$center_ink[py$labels == 1]), 1)` for a 1,
and a 3 is open on the left, so its left ink averages `r round(mean(py$left_ink[py$labels == 3]), 1)`
against `r round(mean(py$left_ink[py$labels == 8]), 1)` for an 8.

:::
